texts.1fb3996c967c: Short title: Management of breast cancer for women aged 65+ in Northwest England Long title: Management of breast cancer for women aged 65+ in Northwest England: The role of general health, tumour characteristics and patient preference in treatment decisions The primary aim of this study is to investigate the extent to which increasing age predicts surgical management of operable breast cancer for older women when tumour characteristics, general health and patient preferences are accounted for. The secondary aim is to determine which health measures best predict post surgical outcomes. Data access is restricted to those named in section 7 of this agreement. Any changes will be notified to the NHS IC.

Short title: Management of breast cancer for women aged 65+ in Northwest England
Long title: Management of breast cancer for women aged 65+ in Northwest England: The role of general health, tumour characteristics and patient preference in treatment decisions

The primary aim of this study is to investigate the extent to which increasing age predicts surgical management of operable breast cancer for older women when tumour characteristics, general health and patient preferences are accounted for.

The secondary aim is to determine which health measures best predict post surgical outcomes.

Data access is restricted to those named in section 7 of this agreement. Any changes will be notified to the NHS IC.
